title: Pin and read hosted source
responsibility: Resolve repository refs into a cache identity and read regular artifacts with verified content bindings.

inputs.name: hubSource.input
inputs.type: { source: SourceHistoryAdapter; cache: CollaborationCache; actor: Actor; project: Project & { collaborationCommit?: string }; ref: string; }
inputs.description: Source adapter, cache, actor, authorized project and requested ref; optional collaboration commit joins the cache identity.

inputs.name: hubRead.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubRead.path
inputs.description: Exact repository path of a regular or executable blob in the context tree.

inputs.name: hubRead.hash
inputs.description: Expected SHA-256, or null by default.

outputs.name: hubSource
outputs.description: Context containing resolved commit/tree, source entries and an identity binding actor, project, repository, requested ref, collaboration revision and optional notes/evidence pins.

outputs.name: hubRead
outputs.description: Verified raw file bytes or materialized Git LFS bytes. Missing regular paths are refused; raw blob identity, requested hash and LFS length are checked, with cache helpers enforcing the LFS content hash.
